remediationAssessment.improvement: Every staged Reading row now exposes canonical question text, canonical key and a literal excerpt in the guided rationale, while retaining the source-ledger rationale.
remediationAssessment.remainingDefect: For 440 rows the generated paragraph is still a fixed assertion template and the retained source-ledger rationale is also generic or a bare verdict. The pair does not explain why the cited language entails, contradicts or fails to state the proposition.
remediationAssessment.notGivenFinding: All 40 NOT GIVEN/NOT STATED rows were rechecked under the passage-wide absence rule. Twenty-two have a question-specific source rationale that identifies the missing proposition; eighteen remain assertion-only and fail closed.

reviewPolicy.passRequires: All 40 rows must bind to canonical Q1-Q40, responseKey/type/question/part and current hashes; excerpts must be literal in the located passage; and the effective rationale pair must explain the semantic relationship rather than merely assert support.
reviewPolicy.notGivenRule: A cited paragraph cannot by itself prove NOT GIVEN. The review requires a question-specific statement of the missing proposition and passage-wide absence from both the proposition and its contrary.
reviewPolicy.approvalMeaning: PASS applies only to this Reading evidence gate and the exact hashes in this report. It is not release, runtime-integration or human-QA approval.
